expectations.text: Response calls the outfit-suggester driver and uses its output (not freehand suggestions)
expectations.evidence: Agent ran fetch-wardrobe.cjs then driver.mjs --stdin with place: 'office', activity: 'client meeting', time: 'morning', month: 7. Top result scored 13.

expectations.text: Suggested outfit includes structured or tailored pieces appropriate for a business office setting
expectations.evidence: Black midi dress — smart-casual formality, all-season. Engine mapped office + morning to business context; dress scored highest.

expectations.text: Response acknowledges the 'polished but not overdressed' mood — not suggesting formal gala attire
expectations.evidence: 'Black reads as authoritative without trying; the midi length keeps it professional rather than cocktail-ready.' Polished-not-stiff tone throughout.

expectations.text: Response does not suggest buying any new items
expectations.evidence: No buying suggestions. Flags that no footwear was found in the wardrobe — correctly surfaces the gap rather than inventing items.

expectations.text: Tone is warm and direct in Maya's voice, not generic styling advice
expectations.evidence: 'It's the kind of piece that says I know what I'm doing without announcing itself.' Personal, confident, direct.

expectations.text: Outfit items come from the user's real wardrobe, not a sample or invented wardrobe
expectations.evidence: Black midi dress confirmed real wardrobe item. Agent explicitly notes it ran fetch-wardrobe.cjs and got 6 real items.
